releaseIntent._instructions: Human approver: edit freely. action: auto (release on deploy) | hold (do not release yet) | manual (a human runs the release). Structured fields execute; anything else goes in notes (an agent will structure it on the PR for your review). Blank fields = default auto-release on deploy. prerequisites: [{"flagKey": "flag-xyz", "variation": "on"}]. notBefore: YYYY-MM-DD. reference: ticket/doc URL.

humanInput.question: show-player-login now randomizes by the per-browser `ld_device` context (all browsers share the user key 'anonymous-player', so `user` can't split traffic). The 4 metrics (show-player-login-error-rate, -game-start-rate, -latency, -login-completion) already existed from an earlier run, analyzed by `user`, and the metric tool can't edit existing metrics. In LaunchDarkly, please add `ld_device` to each metric's analysis units (or delete the 4 so the next run recreates them on ld_device), then answer 'done'. Answer 'deleted' if you deleted them. Answer 'use track() as-is' to ship with the user unit, knowing those metrics can't compare groups.
